sources: File names, sizes and SHA-256 read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-11-24; revisions pinned. Ladder and add-ons follow docs/research/04-model-eval-mac.md: Qwen3.5-0.8B is not offered, the unrestricted add-on exists only where the Qwen3.5-4B or Gemma 4 E4B variant fits, at most 8 tools in a prompt. Memory numbers stay provisional until the device spike lands. 2026-11-25: six store-only alternatives added (SmolLM3 3B, Granite 4.0 Micro, Ministral 3 3B/8B, Phi-4 mini, Qwen3.5 9B Unrestricted); repo, revision, size and SHA-256 read from the Hugging Face API, licences from the model cards (Apache-2.0 / MIT); not evaluated, not on any ladder, class defaults unchanged. 2026-11-25 (serial 2026112502): Gemma 4 12B no longer held back (llama.cpp 32561 is open but hits every Gemma 4 size and did not show in our runs); store-only additions Llama 3.2 1B/3B, Llama 3.1 8B, Granite 4.1 3B/8B, Ministral 3 14B, DeepSeek R1 1.5B/7B/8B, Phi-4 mini Reasoning, Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B/7B, and an unrestricted counterpart (baseModel) for every standard size that has a credible one; repo, revision, size and SHA-256 read from the Hugging Face API; not evaluated; class defaults and ladders unchanged.
